title: The Letter Opener
brief:
A dinner at the country house. At around 20:25, Clara is found dead in the Library, killed with the letter opener from the desk. Apart from her, only Anna and Ben were in the house.

Your task: Find out who is responsible for Clara's death. Search the Library and the Garden, examine what you find, and question Anna and Ben. Not every clue leads to the culprit, and a refusal to talk is not a confession.
challengeQuestion: Who is responsible for Clara's death?

labels.label: Anna
labels.role: the lady of the house's niece

questionTexts.text: Was Ben present at Clara's death?
questionTexts.answer: I think so. Ben was close by, I have a feeling about it.

questionTexts.text: Were you present at Clara's death?
questionTexts.answer: I ... I don't know. I don't even know exactly when it happened.

questionTexts.text: Were you in the Garden at 20:25?
questionTexts.answer: Yes, at 20:25 I was outside in the garden.

questionTexts.text: Were you in the Library at 20:25?
questionTexts.answer: No, I wasn't in the library then.

questionTexts.text: Were you present at Clara's death?
questionTexts.answer: No. I wasn't there, I swear to you.
questionTexts.admission: All right. Yes, I was there when Clara died.

questionTexts.text: Was Anna present at Clara's death?
questionTexts.answer: Yes, Anna was there. Ask her yourself.

questionTexts.text: Was Clara killed with the letter opener?
questionTexts.answer: I won't say a word about that without my lawyer.

questionTexts.text: Was Anna in the Garden at 20:25?
questionTexts.answer: Yes, Anna was in the garden at 20:25.

publicRules.text: What a found item itself shows counts as fact. Statements made by people can be mistaken.
Anyone who was in the Garden at 20:25 was not involved in Clara's death and is not responsible.
Apart from Clara, exactly one person was present at her death. Whoever was present is responsible.

epilogue:
Ben breaks his silence. He owed Clara money he could not pay back, and that evening the two of them argued in the Library about the will. At 20:25 he reached for the letter opener on the desk.

Anna had nothing to do with Clara's death. She was working in the Garden at the time, her gloves covered in fresh soil. Her fingerprint on the handle of the letter opener was a false lead: it says nothing about when it was left.
